name: Foundry: Single Hammer
design_intent:
FOUNDRY: SINGLE HAMMER — THE FOUNDRY circuit's rotor ON-RAMP (tier 1; brawl_arena_expansion_2026-07-19 Foundry row 7). ONE big spinning smelt-hammer sweeps over the CENTER island B of the validated flagship three-island / one-void shape (the ember-palette sibling of the shipped hammer_arena). A single bold blade on a slow readable rotation with a long apex dwell = the clear beat; islands A/C are permanent refuges and B's edges sit below the arc. Single-family (hammer only), lowest Foundry tier.

DOCTRINE FIT: (1) LETHAL — the blade head instakills on contact via kill(&ring_out); no shove/hitstun. (2) TELEGRAPHY — a slow ~4.5s rotation with arc_deg 150 (<360) so a >=120deg / ~1.08s clear window ALWAYS returns at each apex; at the bottom of the swing the head sits ~y1070 over B's center, toward the apexes it rises HIGH and out over the gaps (safe crossing altitude). (3) FAIRNESS — the blade never covers B's edges (below the arc) or islands A/C (permanent refuges); no player spawns under the blade (spawns on A/C). (4) CREDIT — a blade kill with no attacker = uncredited self-fall (killer=-1); a rival knocked into the blade within the 6.0s ring-out window is credited; no environment scorer.

GEOMETRY (symmetric flagship void_is_floor): three flat trampoline islands over ONE full-width void: A x0..900 / B x1580..2480 (HAMMER, hub x2030) / C x3160..4060, all top y1080, separated by 680px void gaps. Bounds -610..4670 x, top -2090, bottom 1878 (>=650px recovery sky; outer edges 610px inside side blast lines). Molten open_sky (clouds off, horizon glow).

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP (flight-required; Tuning: trampoline apex 270px => ~395px zero-boost drift; max spring drift ~527px; normal_boost_max 760 crosses 680px in ~0.9-1.0s):
- GAP A<->B (x900..x1580 = 680px over void): > 527 and >> 395. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; miss = fall into the void. Verb: FLY.
- GAP B<->C (x2480..x3160 = 680px over void): identical. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- DODGE the hammer on B: cross/land on B's central strip only on the apex-dwell clear beat, else hug an edge (below the arc). The arc over the gaps is HIGH (above crossing altitude), so it never makes a required crossing uncrossable. Verb: DODGE (+ TIME).
- Zero-boost off any island reaches NO other surface across a 680px gap: flight is REQUIRED; the hammer reshapes/times the fight on B.

SIGNATURE / DISTINCT: the Foundry's solo-rotor read (foundry_smelter pairs it with a crusher; foundry_hammer_and_pour adds debris). One-line read: 'time the swing across the middle island and knock rivals into the blade.'
